title: XSD temporal and duration value family
api_or_output: Internal XSD datatype family implementation; no partial public validator

acceptance.description: Implement the complete XSD1.0 dateTime/time/date/gYearMonth/gYear/gMonthDay/gDay/gMonth/duration lexical and value spaces through the verified family contract, with arbitrary year/fraction precision, calendar validation, timezone absence/presence, prescribed partial ordering and consistent equality/hash.

Test leap/calendar/year/24-hour/timezone boundaries, arbitrary magnitudes, fractions, missing-timezone indeterminacy, duration reference-point comparisons and valid/invalid lexical forms. Account work/growth, exact-limit/one-over and cancellation without inventing a total order.

Compile against verified model/core only; record normative pinned-edition cases and applicable allocation/performance evidence. Keep family source/tests independent of unmerged numeric/text branches; final library composition belongs to M8-datatypes.

handoff.summary: Planned bounded child of M8-datatypes; original complete XSD1.0 acceptance and gate reachability preserved.
